info.title: Gaap Unity Data-Api Documentation
info.description:
The GAAP Unity Enterprise REST API can be used to query data collections for the GAAP Unity instance. The query results can be filtered, sorted and limited by using the parameters below. The purpose of the API is allow 3rd Parties to collect data for Business Intelligence, Accounting Integration and any other integrations that require data to be collected and injected into the 3rd party system.
    
	Example: {{endpoint}}/sales?apikey={{apikey}}&match=[("createdDate","gte","20220501"), ("createdDate","lte","20220613")]&sort=[("closedDate","asc")]
		
	eq = Equal
	lt = less than (Dates and times should be formatted as YYYYMMDDHHmm or YYYYMMDD )
	gt = greater than
	lte = less than or equal
	gte = greater than or equal
	in = array of values value = "["v1","v2"]"
	nin = not in
	limit: number e.g. &limit=10
	skip: number e.g. &skip=10

	sort: direction can be either desc, asc or left out (ascending default). e.g. &sort=[("name","asc")]
